notes.title: 2023.03.28 Patch notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Fix Save/Import Bug[/h1]
	[list]
[*]    Fix a bug where saving/reloading did not work properly after changing the child picture
[*] 	Fixed a bug where the previous interaction remained after saving/recalling the gate plot
[*] 	Fix a bug that first appeared in the room after saving/recalling the conversation
[*] 	Fix a bug where the color puzzle was automatically solved
[*] 	Modify the UI of an already resolved puzzle to not reappear
[*] 	Link brush color on recall
[*] 	Change to display the brush UI immediately if the item used during loading is a brush
[*] 	Fix a bug where blue and green pictures were displayed strangely after saving/recalling them
[*] 	Fixed a bug where yellow pictures were fading animation when the game was called up
[*] 	Modify the server when the knob changes to store/discharging/bullying when you come to save the storage/discharging/discharging
[*] 	Fix points where telescopes were not saved or not used
[*] 	Modifying a book that was not saved again
[/list]


[h1]Fix the Ending[/h1]
[list]
[*] 	Fix a bug where the ending didn't go well
[*] 	Modify the ending to proceed naturally by hiding the menu button at the end of the ending interaction
[/list]


[h1] Fix other bugs[/h1]
     [list]
[*]    Remove mysterious text from puzzles and fix bugs that didn't display numbers properly
[*]    Fixed a bug that allowed me to get a battery without opening the drawer
[*]    Fixes the fact that the blackout effect did not cover the entire screen while red was directing
[*]    Change the last puzzle to automatically save the last puzzle
[/list]


+The previous version of the previous version A cannot be used in this update version ATific.I'm sorry to use it.

notes.title: 2023.03.04 UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h3]1. We have added a function that can be saved through the save and exit buttons on the in-game menu by confirming that an error occurs when the save time is set to the end of the game.[/h3]
Save file storage location is as follows:
(User folder/AppData/LocalLow/TeamCreator/ARTificial/ -> Game folder)

[h3]2. We have added a semi-skip function that allows you to view credit through left-click.[/h3]


※ Items to be updated soon
- Add sound adjustment function from the main screen
- Add hint function
